name: Source Code & Artifact Repository
description: A source-code and artifact repository — also called Git/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, an artifact registry, container/image registry, Nexus/Artifactory, or package repo — that stores source, build artifacts, and container images feeding deployments. The origin of the supply chain into production. The place to look for the code repository, Git host, artifact/package/container registry, or where source and build outputs are stored.
